atlas_home_region_card.compact: Detroit soul-pop precision: Black vocal brilliance, studio discipline, and hooks built for crossover impact.
atlas_home_region_card.standard: It changed the sound of American pop and created a model for Black music crossing radio boundaries without losing identity.
atlas_home_region_card.deep: Detroit soul-pop precision: Black vocal brilliance, studio discipline, and hooks built for crossover impact. It changed the sound of American pop and created a model for Black music crossing radio boundaries without losing identity.

region_scene_page.compact: Motown turned a Detroit house studio into a national hit factory, pairing songwriters, arrangers, house musicians, and artist development into a repeatable pop-soul machine.
region_scene_page.standard: Motown turned a Detroit house studio into a national hit factory, pairing songwriters, arrangers, house musicians, and artist development into a repeatable pop-soul machine. The Miracles' Shop Around, The Marvelettes' Please Mr. Postman, Marvin Gaye's Can I Get a Witness, and The Contours' Do You Love Me give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Motown turned a Detroit house studio into a national hit factory, pairing songwriters, arrangers, house musicians, and artist development into a repeatable pop-soul machine. The groove is tight, the chorus is instant, and every part sounds arranged for lift. The Miracles' Shop Around, The Marvelettes' Please Mr. Postman, Marvin Gaye's Can I Get a Witness, and The Contours' Do You Love Me give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
